legal_units.title: Deduction in respect of purchase of electric vehicle.
legal_units.text: An assessee, being an individual, shall be allowed a deduction of interest payable on loan taken by him from any financial institution for the purpose of purchase of an electric vehicle, as per the provisions of this section.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 132 Deduction in respect of purchase of electric vehicle. Section 132(1): An assessee, being an individual, shall be allowed a deduction of interest payable on loan taken by him from any financial institution for the purpose of purchase of an electric vehicle, as per the provisions of this section.

legal_units.title: Deduction in respect of purchase of electric vehicle.
legal_units.text: The deduction under sub-section (1) shall be subject to the condition that the loan has been sanctioned by the financial institution during the period beginning on the 1st April, 2019 and ending on the 31st March, 2023.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 132 Deduction in respect of purchase of electric vehicle. Section 132(2): The deduction under sub-section (1) shall be subject to the condition that the loan has been sanctioned by the financial institution during the period beginning on the 1st April, 2019 and ending on the 31st March, 2023.

legal_units.title: Deduction in respect of purchase of electric vehicle.
legal_units.text: The deduction under sub-section (1) shall not exceed Rs. 150000 and shall be allowed in computing the total income of the individual for the tax year beginning on the 1st April, 2019 and subsequent tax years.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 132 Deduction in respect of purchase of electric vehicle. Section 132(3): The deduction under sub-section (1) shall not exceed Rs. 150000 and shall be allowed in computing the total income of the individual for the tax year beginning on the 1st April, 2019 and subsequent tax years.

legal_units.title: Deduction in respect of purchase of electric vehicle.
legal_units.text: Where a deduction under this section is allowed for any interest referred to in sub-section (1), deduction shall not be allowed in respect of such interest under any other provision of this Act for the same or any other tax year.
